target.statement: Empirical specificity of the proposed 'Ours (full)' method for IID errors, mean function μ1, n=50, standard normal errors (N), reported as 98.3%.
target.table_ref: Table 1, Panel A, row 'Ours (full)', column n=50, N
target.dataset: Synthetic simulation data generated from model (3) with μ1 and i.i.d. N(0,1) errors rescaled to sd 1/20, 1000 time series without outliers.

code_links_note: The paper links a GitHub repository for the experiments, but the simulation data is synthetic and generated by the code; no external data download is needed for this target.

compute.basis: The target is a single cell from a simulation study: 1000 synthetic time series of length 550, local linear regression with cross-validated bandwidth, and GEV fitting; this is small-scale CPU work, but the repository may need adaptation or reimplementation.

blockers: Repository may not be fully reproducible out of the box (partial release); code may need debugging or reimplementation of the simulation and GEV fitting pipeline.
title: Sequential Outlier Detection in Non-Stationary Time Series
